ORDINANCE



        BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all the B3-1 Community Shopping District, C1-1 Neighborhood Commercial District,
M1-1 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District, RS-2 and RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached
House) Districts , and RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols and
identification as shown on Maps No. 26-F and 28-F in the area bounded by:

        West 107th Street; the alley next east of and parallel to Union Pacific Railroad; south right-of way
        line of the alley next south of and parallel to West 107th Place; a line 31.02 feet east of and parallel
        to the alley next east of and parallel to the Union Pacific Railroad; West 108th Street; a line 62.02
        feet east and parallel to the alley next east of and parallel to the Union Pacific Railroad; the alley
        next south of and parallel to West 108th Street; a line 61.85 feet east of and parallel to Union Pacific
        Railroad; West 108th Place; a line 61.80 feet east and parallel to the alley next east of and parallel
        to the Union Pacific Railroad; the alley next south of and parallel to West 108th Place; a line 50.00
        feet east of and parallel to the alley next east of and parallel to Union Pacific Railroad; West 109th
        Place; the alley next east of and parallel to Union Pacific Railroad; the alley next south of and
        parallel to West 109th Place and extended where no street exists; a line 34.00 feet west of and
        parallel to the alley; next west of and parallel to South Princeton Avenue; West 110th Street; the
        alley next west of and parallel to South Princeton Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to
        West 110th Street; a line 475.00 feet west of and parallel to South Princeton Avenue; West 110th
        Place; the alley next west of and parallel to South Princeton Avenue; West 111th Street; a line
        312.50 feet west of and parallel to South Princeton Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to
        West 111th Street; a line 325.00 feet west of and parallel to South Princeton Avenue; the alley next
        south of and parallel to West 111th Place; a line 368.75 feet west of and parallel to South Princeton
        Avenue; West 112th Street; a line 309.00 feet west of and parallel to South Princeton Avenue; the
        alley next south of and parallel to West 112th Street; a line 262.50 feet west of and parallel to South
        Princeton Avenue; West 112th Place; a line 150.00 feet west of and parallel to South Princeton

        parallel West 113th Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Yale Avenue; a line 518.67
        feet south of and parallel to West 113th Street; South Wentworth Avenue; West 114th Street; a line

        Pacific Railroad; South Wentworth Avenue, south right-of-way line of South 114th Street;
        northeast right-of-way line of Union Pacific Railroad; South Princeton Avenue; south right-of-way
        line of the alley next south of and parallel to West 113th Street; northeast right-of-way line of Union
        Pacific Railroad; West 112th Street; the alley next east of and parallel to Union Pacific Railroad;
        West 111th Street; east right-of-way line of Union Pacific Railroad; north right-of-way line of the
        alley next south of and parallel to West 107th Place and extended where no street exists; east right-
        of-way line of Union Pacific Railroad (RLE Rezoning Section 3)
